component.name: GStreamer Multimedia Codecs - Extra
component.summary: Multimedia playback and encoding for AAC, AV1, DTS, H.264, H.265 and more

description.p: This addon includes several additional codecs that are missing something - perhaps a good code review, some documentation, a set of tests, a real live maintainer, or some actual wide use. However, they might be good enough to play your media files.

This build includes all the plugins, including codecs for formats that might be patent encumbered, such as AAC, DTS, H.264 and H.265, and hardware accelerated encoding and decoding through VA-API, NVIDIA NVCODEC, Intel Quick Sync Video and Vulkan.
A codec decodes audio and video for playback or editing and is also used for transmission or storage. Different codecs are used in video-conferencing, streaming media and video editing applications.
